scope: Static review only of the exact collector plus current owned receipt/file shapes. Collector was not imported or executed; no native execution by reviewer. This is not a product qualification or an audit of collected output not yet produced.

findings.problem: Prior selector also admitted defaultRamp1s pressure control, so sorting random temporary directory paths could publish the wrong fullhistory FRD/DAT body.
findings.resolution: Final selector requires a successful actual-command NativeE4k gate with origins bound to the current candidate, selects latest by original receiptmtime with criterion declared in manifest, and requires exactly one pressure1s/currentbinary deck with one actual STEP card containing AMPLITUDE=STEP. Ramp control cannot qualify.

findings.problem: Prior generic request-prefix branch could also copy an unpublished .out.tmp body outside rawcontact budget.
findings.resolution: Temporary contact outputs are always hashonly; generic owned requestfile branch now requires an exact32hex requestname.

findings.problem: Copying every positive contactbody across native and full-FEM repeatedfixtures could exceed the frozen256MiB bytebudget.
findings.resolution: Raw bodies explicitly limited to selected currentcandidate dedicated NativeE4k and successful actual GuiE4k gates; repeated broad/earlier-positive bodies remain explicit size/hash/reason entries. Budget remains unchanged and refuses before creating the target.

checks: Existing evidence target and target symlink refuse; destination is constrained beneath repository package/local-completion. Duplicate/unsafe public destinations refuse.

Original execution receipts are copied byte-for-byte without sourcepath rebasing or verdict rewriting. Historical loghashes are checked against their receipts. Explicit failed/no-test/inputchanged classifications remain negative, including native-r03.
Positive-gate selection is separate labelled collection metadata; raw recorded returncodes/pass/semantic/helper/source custody fields are retained. Collector never emits a productpass verdict.

Currentcandidate selectors bind actual command module/origins or physical receipt, nativehash and dedicated-case identity. Mechanical native pair selected only from successful MechanicalE4k/currentcandidate report with exactly two expected FRD directories.

Named product sources, current helpers, upstream GPL code context and exact hash-resolved historical code bodies are retained. Opaque blobs are used only for approved named code/helper pins. Unavailable exact historical code bodies remain explicitly unresolved, never replaced by a newer source hash.

Known environments/profiles/config/cache and nativebuild trees are pruned before traversal. CAD/geometry/mesh, binaries/objects, complete official manual bodies and profileinventory maps are excluded from public bodies. Selected generated scientific FRD/DAT/contact outputs remain explicit analytical fixture evidence.
Duplicate saved literal bodies have explicit derived summaries with original raw size/hash and per-literal size/hash; full native sourcebody selection is separately recorded.
Unselected private nativebulk has exact original path/size/hash and reason; exclusions and bodyselection policy are explicit. No blanket claim to preserve every private body is made.

All exact body/source hashes are checked before and after copying. Every written exact/generated artifact is indexed with size/hash/kind/source provenance, and index self-exclusion is explicit with external index hash returned to root.
All planning, requiredcase selection, bodybudget checks and source reads precede target creation. No application, solver, compiler or native code is executed by collector.
remaining_requirements: Root must execute only after all serial gates finish and source inputs freeze.

Postcollection review must verify actual generated artifact index/content/exclusions and final validation claims; this static review alone does not establish collection completeness or feature completion.
